scope: Shared Claude Code and Codex review-inbox skill; not product delivery acceptance.

entryPoints.sharedWorkflow: Claude loads the canonical Codex-compatible skill and its resources; no duplicated workflow.

tests.environment: Native Windows Node with disposable Git repositories
coverage: Multiple submissions and duplicate ref grouping
Empty placeholders excluded and local drafts reported separately
Exact-submission response receipts and new unanswered revisions
Path validation, literal Git path matching and external notes directories
Malformed work configuration and non-string document IDs rejected
History window and manifest truncation warnings
Commit date ordering across timezone offsets and separate author dates
Git files, branch, config and raw index bytes preserved
Case-insensitive Git redirect environment isolation and isolated fixtures

independentForwardTest.scenario: Two recent submissions, a dirty current checkout and another chat's unverified worktree/server
independentForwardTest.outcome: Asked which review to open, preserved edits and refused to reuse the unverified workspace/server. All reported implementation and portability findings closed after fixes.

limitations: Actual worktree creation, selected-branch launcher startup and browser opening were not executed during skill creation. They remain host-agent workflow steps when the user selects a review.
Native macOS/Linux operation and live discovery by restarted Claude/Codex sessions have not been exercised.
Reply status records an explicit receipt, not semantic proof that every question was answered or permission to implement.

repositoryPatternCheck.error: Review is stale or missing: inspect changes and refresh sourceDigest
repositoryPatternCheck.reason: Concurrent delivery and review-tool changes require their owning complete source review. This scoped skill review does not refresh the global digest.
